tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: Search dive-site summaries. Each item includes a verification tier and a canonical URL for citation.

tools.name: get_site_plate
tools.description: Full plate for a slug, including verification, sources, and the canonical URL.

tools.name: get_latest_conditions
tools.description: Timestamped condition reports for a plate. Diver names, emails, and user IDs are omitted. Includes verification.

tools.name: list_centres
tools.description: Public centre fields already shown on centre pages. No phone, email, or ranking.

tools.name: check_suitability
tools.description: Rule-based suitability for one plate. Returns status, reasons, verification, sources, and the canonical URL. Does not recommend a centre.

tools.name: get_atlas_overview
tools.description: Country and area coverage with a verification breakdown and hub URLs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_sites, get_site_plate, get_latest_conditions, list_centres, check_suitability, get_atlas_overview · Public sink: list_centres.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_sites, get_site_plate, get_latest_conditions, list_centres, check_suitability, get_atlas_overview · Public sink: list_centres

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
